capabilities.description: Clubs can book the whole rink or half of it at an hourly rate. Their bookings reduce how many public tickets a session can sell, and each club gets a monthly invoice for the hours it booked.
capabilities.name: Club rink booking and monthly invoicing

capabilities.description: Skaters can register as members under a membership number, and members get a free-entry allowance.
capabilities.name: Membership registration and free-entry allowance

capabilities.description: Managers can schedule skating sessions, publish the schedule in time order and get weekly reports on sessions.
capabilities.name: Skating session scheduling and reporting

capabilities.description: Skaters can buy priced tickets for a session and pay through the external PuckPay payment provider. Payment results are settled, unpaid bookings expire after their payment window, and refunds can be issued.
capabilities.name: Ticket sales and payment settlement

capabilities.description: Ice temperature readings are recorded. A sustained warm spell puts the next session on hold and skaters are notified. The held session can then be cancelled with refunds or released for sale again.
capabilities.name: Ice safety monitoring and session hold

capabilities.description: The rink keeps a fixed stock of hire skates for each shoe size and checks availability against pending and paid bookings.
capabilities.name: Skate hire
